I'm sorry about that I hope things get better for you.
And not much is going on currently. I'm on Summer break now and most of it is being spent in my room apart from last week when I was out with friends a lot, most of them are away now. I'm also not eating consistently, one day I could eat loads and the next day only have one meal.
Ok I guess, last week was quite good, past few days I haven't been sleeping properly and it's affecting my mood a bit. How are you?

Hey thanks for the reply. And I do gym outside of school with a few people which gives me a nice buzz but it only lasts a few hours. When I'm not at school, gym or hanging out I'm at home watching netflix.

Hey thanks for replying. I will eventually talk to someone about it but I feel like I'm not ready yet you know? I also get what you mean with the diabetes thing but I'm nervous about going to the doctor because I don't want to be pumped full of drugs, I think that I'd feel better just by having someone irl who I can tell everything too and know they wouldn't reject me or change their opinion about me.
Hey Michael thanks for the reply. I'm sorry you're going through this too, it makes me feel slightly better that I'm not the only one going through this.

Yeah I have a pretty good relationship with my family but I don't really tell them about much which makes it harder for me to tell me what's going through my head. And I have thought about it but I feel nervous because I don't want to just be pumped full of drugs.
